dict.string: Optional convenience: reads the current browser tab's address so a reminder can link back to the page. If you decline, reminders work the same — just without the link.
Needed only by the {slot} snippet placeholder to read your calendar and find free time for meeting proposals. Nothing is created or modified, and every other snippet works without it.
Griasa uses the microphone for dictation and conversation recording. Without it, all text and screen features keep working.
Needed only by “Remind me” to create the reminders you ask for. Nothing else in Griasa uses this access.
